cases.case_label: SVA_E in SMARCB1 intron 2 (familial ATRT, maternal mosaic)
cases.disease: Atypical teratoid rhabdoid tumor (rhabdoid tumor predisposition)
cases.mechanism_detail: A 2,763-bp SVA_E inserted 33 bp downstream of SMARCB1 exon 2 causes splicing from a premature donor in exon 2 into a splice acceptor in the SVA Alu-like domain (exon1-SVA transcript), plus low-level exon 2 skipping, disrupting the allele. Inherited by two affected siblings from their mosaic mother; tumours showed second-hit LOH.
cases.quote: Our results indeed verified the presence of splicing from exon 2 into the Alu‐like domain of SVA‐E, one of the previously recognized splice acceptor sites (Figure 4).
